description: The pie chart titled “6 Matches” depicts the distribution of outcomes across seven labeled categories (0 through 6), shown as seven slices with percentage and count annotations inside each segment. The largest slice is label 6, colored medium blue, at approximately 27.2% (8006). The next largest is label 2, in a pale green, at about 22.4% (6583). Two similarly sized slices follow: label 1 in light orange at about 13.8% (4046) and label 0 in very light peach at about 13.3% (3910). Smaller slices include label 5 in light blue at about 10.4% (3043), label 3 in light green at about 6.8% (2002), and label 4 in light blue-gray at about 6.2% (1810). There is no separate legend; labels are placed around the pie with percentages and counts printed within slices, and no segments appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice sizes appear roughly arranged from larger to smaller around the chart.
